title: Setup answers surviving the app closing are never tested on a phone
what: The only test packs and unpacks the kept answers as text. No test closes the app mid-setup and checks the welcome reopens on the same step with the name and kg filled, that a failed Start training keeps them, that they are cleared once the profile is made, or that nothing is sent before Start training.
expected: A phone test that types the name and number, closes the app, reopens it on the same step, finishes, and sees the answers gone.
fix_line: Add a phone test that closes the app halfway through setup and checks the answers come back, then go

title: The start-up error screen is seen on a phone only for a file that will not open, never for a full phone or a failed read or update
what: The phone test breaks the data file so it will not open. The full-phone screen, the 'couldn't read your data' screen and the 'couldn't finish updating' screen are checked only as stored values, and only the end of their sentences; their title and buttons are never seen.
expected: Each start-up failure shows its own exact words, the title, and the Try again, Save my data file and Details buttons, checked on screen.
fix_line: Check the exact words of every start-up failure, and show the full-phone one on a phone

title: No test checks the first-opened time is written once and never moved
what: Tests read a first-opened time that is already there. None checks that start-up writes it only on the first launch, keeps it after a failed start or a later launch, or never sends it to MettleUp or the gym. If it moved to today, older workouts would silently stop being offered.
expected: A test that starts the app twice, and after a failed start, and sees the same first-opened time each time.
fix_line: Add a start-up test that the first-opened time is kept as it was

title: Settings kept by an older version, or damaged, are never tested to keep the member's choices
what: The settings are joined with new defaults when the app starts, so a member on an older version keeps kg or lb and the rest. No test feeds an older or broken settings record and checks the choices stay and nothing crashes.
expected: A test that loads an older and a damaged settings record and sees the member's units kept and new choices at their defaults.
fix_line: Add a test that old and broken settings keep the member's choices

title: No test checks an AI key stays out of the plain settings, or the coach choices hide when the coach is off
what: The coach-off case is checked only by reading the page's code text. Nothing checks that an AI key added on an older build is never kept in the plain settings store, which is copied into backups.
expected: A test that settings saved with an AI key never hold the key, and a screen test that the coach choices are hidden when the coach is off.
fix_line: Add a test that no key is kept in the plain settings, and show the coach-off Settings in a phone test

title: Light or dark is never tested with a workout open, or for the first frame after a restart
what: Phone tests tap the three choices and switch the phone's look, but only take pictures; nothing asserts the new look. No test switches the phone to dark while a workout or hold timer is open, or checks the first frame after a restart is already in the chosen look.
expected: A test that switches the phone's look mid-workout and sees the open sheet and timer kept, and a restart that starts in the chosen look.
fix_line: Add a test that changes light or dark during a workout and after a restart

title: No phone test checks the gym's look for an owner, trainer or desk staff
what: The gym look tests join as a member only. Nothing checks what an owner, trainer or desk staff signed in on the phone app sees: the gym's colours, MettleUp's, or another gym's.
expected: A test per gym role that the phone shows only that gym's look, or MettleUp's.
fix_line: Add gym look tests signed in as owner, trainer and desk staff
